title: React Developer
description:
About The Company

Marvin creates digital experiences that support customers and partners throughout their interactions with the company. We are committed to building useful, reliable products and continually improving how people access information and services. Our teams bring together technology, product, design, and business expertise to solve meaningful challenges. At Marvin, thoughtful collaboration and quality engineering help turn ideas into practical solutions. We value sustainable development practices, clear communication, and an environment where people can share knowledge and grow while delivering work that makes a difference.

About The Role

Marvin is seeking a Senior React Developer to lead front-end development for customer-facing features and our partner experience portal. This is a hands-on technical leadership role: you will build polished interfaces, guide architectural decisions, and help the web team strengthen its development practices. You will work closely with product management, UX, Enterprise Architecture, and other stakeholders to understand needs and deliver maintainable solutions.

You will develop React applications using TypeScript, integrate interfaces with REST APIs, and contribute to interactive 3D web experiences built with WebGL technologies such as Three.js or Babylon.js. You will also help deliver cross-platform mobile applications using Ionic Capacitor, React, and TypeScript. In addition to feature development, you will support CI/CD pipelines, maintain project dependencies, resolve technical issues, and improve existing components. Your experience and coaching will help teammates make sound decisions and produce consistent, high-quality work.

Qualifications

At least five years of experience building web applications with React.
Professional experience developing React applications with TypeScript.
Strong understanding of React fundamentals, including functional components, hooks, and the Context API.
Required experience creating interactive 3D web experiences with WebGL using Three.js or Babylon.js.
Required experience developing cross-platform mobile apps with Ionic Capacitor, React, and TypeScript.
Working knowledge of Git and branching strategies.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical decisions to teammates and stakeholders.
Demonstrated ability to mentor and coach colleagues and collaborate across cross-functional teams.
Experience partnering with UX designers is preferred.
Experience working in agile product teams is preferred.

Responsibilities

Design, develop, test, and maintain customer-facing components and applications using React and TypeScript.
Build and support engaging, accessible interfaces for Marvin’s customer experiences and partner portal.
Integrate React components with back-end REST APIs and coordinate with service teams to address integration needs.
Contribute to interactive 3D web features and cross-platform mobile experiences using the required technologies.
Lead code and design reviews, provide constructive feedback, and promote consistent engineering standards.
Mentor less-experienced developers and share practical knowledge that supports their growth.
Collaborate with product management, UX, Enterprise Architecture, and stakeholders to clarify requirements and deliver project outcomes.
Help design scalable, maintainable front-end architecture in partnership with Enterprise Architecture.
Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines that support dependable development and delivery processes.
Keep dependencies current, resolve conflicts, maintain existing React components, and troubleshoot and fix bugs.

Benefits

Marvin offers health insurance, paid holidays, and paid parental leave to support employees and their families. Employees can participate in a 401(k) retirement savings plan with a company match and may be eligible for annual profit sharing. The company also provides a paid Better Living Day, giving employees time away from work to focus on their well-being. Benefits are designed to support financial security, personal health, and a sustainable approach to work.

Equal Opportunity

Marvin is committed to providing equal employment opportunities and fostering a respectful workplace where people can contribute and develop. Employment decisions are made without discrimination and in accordance with applicable laws. We welcome candidates with diverse experiences and perspectives.
